name: @aipowersalon/realtime-contracts
description: Client-safe realtime event contracts (Constitution 13 §77): the ONE event registry (names, versions, rooms, event→screen routing) and the envelope shape, shared by apps/api, packages/realtime-client and every app; plus the server-side emitter port (REALTIME token + RealtimeEmitter interface) that domain modules publish through. Dependency-free and browser-safe.
